subject: [PATCH v4 04/19] selftests/mm: skip khugepaged page cache cases without a PMD folio

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the comment being too verbose and suggested trimming it. Also questioned whether the patch is inferring file-backed khugepaged behavior from shmem.

reviews.author: Mike Rapoport (Microsoft)
reviews.summary: Provided a minor nitpick about the wording of the comment, suggesting it be rephrased to match the code. Also added a Reviewed-by tag.

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch series modifies the khugepaged selftest to skip certain page cache cases where a PMD-sized folio is not supported due to limitations in MAX_PAGECACHE_ORDER on arm64 architectures.
